Two Sunday services (9:15 and 11 AM), recovery ministry, full lifecycle ministry portfolio. For a Dublin or northwest-Columbus-area man wanting a doctrinally stable, scholar-led Grace Brethren church with multi-decade pastoral continuity, Northwest Chapel is one of the strongest options in central Ohio.
